_readme: Single source of truth for every tunable setting in the daily feed.
Read at run time by hermes/brief.md, scripts/validate.mjs,
Change a number here and everything follows — nothing is duplicated in code.
Anything NOT listed here is a hard part of the contract; see schema.md.

locale.localArea: Lugo, Galicia, Spain — the city and its province

research._note: Caps on searching, to stop a run going in circles. Unlike everything else in this file these are enforced by Hermes reading the brief, not by a script — nothing checks afterwards whether they were respected.

photos._note: A card photo fills roughly 1206x1311 physical pixels on the phone. maxLongEdge below that guarantees upscaling; sources below the minimums cannot look good at that size.

sources._note: Starting points, not a closed list. Follow the story wherever it leads, but these are the outlets Shane expects each section to draw on.
